text: At 68', Kingsmoor FC initiated a momentum shift by employing a possession-based build-up aimed at progressive final third entries, recording 7 entries in 8 minutes without generating shots or xG, reflecting a controlled territorial phase rather than direct penetration [#1248]. Their wide, crossing 4-4-2 formation enabled effective field tilt (64.9%) supported by a high pass accuracy (82.5%) and possession at 54.3%, signaling a systematic overload on the flanks to patiently breach Westport Albion’s defensive block. The elevated PPDA of 10.3 for Kingsmoor FC indicates a lower pressing intensity, favoring rest-defense and careful buildup over aggressive pressing triggers, in contrast to Westport Albion’s direct vertical style and more aggressive pressing (PPDA 4.9). Kingsmoor’s approach prioritizes stable progressive passing and territorial control to create crossing opportunities while minimizing turnovers and counterattack risks.
